description: This file defines the UpdateUI class, which provides utility methods for determining weather icon identifiers based on weather conditions and times, and translating day names into localized strings within an Android weather application.

classes.name: UpdateUI
classes.description: A utility class for updating UI elements based on weather conditions and days of the week.

methods.name: getIconID
methods.description: Returns a string identifier for an icon based on weather condition code and time of day.

methods.name: TranslateDay
methods.description: Translates a day name into a localized string resource using Android context.
